entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Billing' to be routed to the correct department.
Support!
Connecting you to a support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse thing. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into that for you. To best help, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more a matter of preference?
Don't try to troubleshoot me. It's not broken, I just hate it! It's uncomfortable and the app is useless. I want to return it. My order number is VF789012.

Okay, thank you for that. Let me just pull up your order... VF789012. I see it was delivered on December 15th, which was 21 days ago. Sir, for wearable devices that have direct skin contact, our return **policy** is typically very strict.
What are you talking about? What policy?

Well, due to **hygiene** and bio-safety protocols, we can't accept returns on these items after a certain period. For **sanitation** reasons, once they've been worn, we can't resell them. I'm afraid after 21 days, it is **too late** to process a refund for buyer's remorse.

ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! 'Too late'? I buy gear from you guys all the time! This is how you treat a loyal customer? You're going to steal my money over some made-up 'sanitation' rule? That's it, get me your manager. I am going to light up your social media and every review site on the internet about this scam!

Sir, I understand your frustration, there's no need to raise your voice. Please, allow me one moment to just double-check the official documentation. I want to be absolutely certain before we proceed.
You better. This is unbelievable.

Okay... one moment... Yes, I'm looking at our knowledge base now. Sir, my apologies. It seems I was mistaken. I was thinking of a different product line with stricter rules. I am looking right at our standard return **policy** and it clearly states all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
Ha! See? I knew it. You just tried to get out of it. So you're going to process my return now, or do I still need to speak to that manager?

That won't be necessary. My sincere apologies for the confusion. I'm initiating the return for you right now. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Fine. Make sure that email shows up.
It will. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
